context:
Goal: a guard or check change gets exactly the review it needs, no more.
Problem (rule): your item 359 b says to skip round 3 unless the change touches a guard or check, or round 2 failed. It does not say whether a fix check that passes before round 3 ends the review of a guard change.
Based on (ruling): item 359 b (Nov 7 14:41 CST): "Skip round 3 unless the change touches a guard or check, or round 2 failed." Asked because it is silent on a passing fix check.
Based on (ruling): decisions/hold-unsafe-after-round-3: from item 271 b, a fix check may follow a FAIL in any round. The lane's reading of 271 b is that a PASS before round 3 counts as that round passing, so no net-value test is owed. Asked again because the coordinator's 22:36 CST reading said round 3 is still owed, and the two conflict. GLOSSARY.md and CLAUDE.md's fix-check text differ from item 359 b on the same point.
Departs from: main, which has no rule on a fix-check PASS before round 3 — one rule, which #1773's check reads.
Meanwhile: #1773 (with runner 8) enforces option a, the stricter side, so it may merge; option b would loosen it later. The coordinator's 22:36 reading is withdrawn until you answer.

options.gain: Every guard change is judged for safety holes once.
options.how: A guard or check change gets round 3 and the net-value test even after a fix check passes in an earlier round.
options.label: Round 3 with the net-value test still runs (recommended)
options.lose: One more review on guard changes that only needed a small fix.

options.how: A fix check that passes before round 3 ends the review, with no net-value test.
options.label: A fix-check pass ends the review
options.lose: A guard change can merge without the net-value test.

reply: You picked a (06:08 CST Nov 8): a guard or check change still gets round 3 and the net-value test after an earlier fix check passes. Routed to the coordinator and lane session_013NEJKzfcSeBe5Ym9pCtxHn; home: step review-rounds-rework. Closed 06:12 CST Nov 8.
short: Guard change: round 3 after a fix-check pass
title: Does a guard or check change still get round 3 after a fix check passes before it?
why: The coordinator recommends a: every guard change should be judged for safety holes once, and #1773 already enforces it.
